description: "Epidemics Examined and Explained: or, Living Germs Proved by Analogy to be..." by John Grove is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. This work delves into the analysis and interpretation of epidemic diseases, positing that they are caused by living germs rather than merely chemical agents.
